extractionStats.candidateNote: Candidate verdict: only write to the reference layer, not the live boundary image; trace it into a closed boundary before generating regions.
extractionStats.draftNote: Draft verdict: written into the editable boundary layer, but still an open draft; broken segments may be discarded, and final output still needs per-region review.
extractionStats.readOnlyNote: Diagnostic verdict: the real base map has severe color collisions here, so this stays read-only and never writes into the boundary image.

recentGeneration.title: Latest batch generation results
recentGeneration.emptyHint: After one batch generation run, this panel tells you whether each region is generated, skipped for leakage, or not generated. Use it to see where the boundary pipeline still needs repair and which rough region drafts still need manual cleanup.

manualView.title: Manual editing and view
manualView.supportHint: Fine-line candidates only help you trace along long lines on the base map. They never write into the boundary image automatically and cannot replace a hand-drawn closed boundary.
manualView.autoSnapToContour: Snap the current red line to the fine-line contour
manualView.finalBoundaryHint: The red line is the final boundary used for region partitioning: the boundary image itself and manual edge additions merge into one obstacle dataset, and erasing only subtracts from that final red line.

selectedRegion.title: Selected region details
selectedRegion.purposeDiagnostic: Only used for sample guidance, magic-wand work, and chain boundary repair; it is excluded automatically from formal mask/graph exports.
selectedRegion.purposeFormal: The mask handles clicking and highlighting; the passage graph only expresses rules-level connectivity.
selectedRegion.truthDiagnostic: Diagnostic sample. It can validate direction but cannot replace formal region truth.
selectedRegion.truthAuthoritative: Explicit truth. The main pipeline consumes this region result directly.
selectedRegion.truthBootstrap: Heuristic bootstrap. It still needs chain refinement or promotion into explicit truth.
selectedRegion.sharedPrintedRuntime: This printed region currently maps to runtime regions: {{names}}.
selectedRegion.runtimeOnlyGuideBlocker: The blocker is not missing drawing work. The current guide target is still bound to `regionIds`, so runtime-only gaps like {{names}} cannot yet be written straight into the workspace authoritative guide file.
selectedRegion.metadataOnlyNote: This only writes workspace metadata and will not edit the formal `region-authoritative-guides.json` directly.
selectedRegion.notePlaceholder: Record why it belongs to this printed region and which formal proof step is still missing.
selectedRegion.authoritativeTruthNote: Explicit truth is consumed directly by the main pipeline and is written into the current workspace when saved.
selectedRegion.diagnosticTruthNote: Diagnostic temporary regions are not written into formal explicit truth; the Beijing sample should keep using the in-tool guide to validate direction.

passages.title: Passages
passages.description: Click an existing passage edge on the map, or drag from one region center to another to create an edge. The left panel only edits the currently selected passage.
passages.empty: No passages yet. Generate regions first, then use auto-fill by adjacency; special passages can still be drawn directly on the map.
